judgments.title: Invoice line-item billing
judgments.judge_note: Recurring multi-source invoice forms converge on customer header fields, repeated billable lines, calculated totals, and a print-safe output area. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are append_structured_rows, extend_table_formulas, add_data_validation, protect_formula_cells, and generate_printable_form; a plausible verifier is to add line rows, preserve totals and tax formulas, and confirm the printable invoice still balances.

judgments.title: Monthly budget control
judgments.judge_note: Rounds 001-005 now keep this pattern anchored on plan-versus-actual variance control, repeated monthly sections, and close review rather than generic project-cost budgeting. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are copy_period_sheet, extend_table_formulas, add_data_validation, protect_formula_cells, group_summarize, and create_pivot_summary; a plausible verifier is to roll a new month, edit budget, actual, or forecast values, and confirm variance, over-budget flags, and locked summary regions stay intact through close.

judgments.title: Project timeline tracker
judgments.judge_note: The refined round-003 boundary holds: these sheets are task-and-date schedules with visible timeline bands, not generic dashboards. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are copy_period_sheet, add_data_validation, protect_formula_cells, group_summarize, and generate_printable_form; a plausible verifier is to edit task dates, owners, or dependencies and confirm the dated task table and timeline placement stay synchronized.

judgments.title: Matrix attendance register
judgments.judge_note: Across rounds 001-009 the matrix boundary remains roadmap-ready rather than merely recurring: the corpus still combines fixed roster bands, school-year and fiscal roll-forward variants, explicit month and year totals, copy-forward formulas, auto-filled new-row calculations, locked rows or columns, and hidden helper-column control across Smartsheet, Vertex42, Template.net, Microsoft Q&A, and earlier seeds, and round-009 adds no counter-evidence that would widen it back into append-only sign-in logs. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are copy_period_sheet, protect_formula_cells, extend_table_formulas, normalize_headers, and append_structured_rows; a plausible verifier is to roll the workbook into a new week, month, or fiscal period, add a roster row, and confirm locked totals, helper-column logic, date formulas, and year-to-date summaries survive growth without breaking the matrix.

judgments.title: Inventory movement and reconciliation log
judgments.judge_note: Round-003 closes the main gap from round-002 by adding direct transaction-led inventory records for receipts, issues, adjustments, and transfers. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are append_structured_rows, reconcile_tables, add_data_validation, extend_table_formulas, and flag_outliers; a plausible verifier is to append movement rows, preserve item identifiers, and confirm running movement and reconciliation outputs stay aligned with stock balances.

judgments.title: Expense reimbursement form
judgments.judge_note: Rounds 003-005 now show a stable reimbursement pattern across Smartsheet, Vertex42, Template.net, and ClickTime: itemized claim rows, receipt-required completeness, approval-state capture, and reimbursement totals remain consistent. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, append_structured_rows, normalize_headers, generate_printable_form, protect_formula_cells, and group_summarize; a plausible verifier is to append claim lines, toggle receipt or approval states, and confirm payable totals, exception cues, and printable reimbursement output stay synchronized.

judgments.title: Service ticket queue
judgments.judge_note: Rounds 004-006 now hold this judgment on queue-first support sheets across Smartsheet, Airtable, Jotform, Documentero, Template.net, and IdeaPlan while excluding intake-form-first request trackers from the registry entry. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, append_structured_rows, protect_formula_cells, group_summarize, and create_pivot_summary; a plausible verifier is to append tickets, update owner, priority, severity, or status, and confirm open, unresolved, overdue, and metrics-sheet summaries remain aligned with the queue table.

judgments.title: Scheduled maintenance log
judgments.judge_note: Rounds 003-006 now show scheduled maintenance as a stable workbook pattern across vehicle, fleet, startup equipment, office equipment, and broader facility schedule variants. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, copy_period_sheet, protect_formula_cells, append_structured_rows, and flag_outliers; a plausible verifier is to append service rows, update next-due timing or ownership, and confirm due-state, cost-history, and schedule summaries stay aligned across equipment and facility maintenance views.

judgments.title: Health metrics tracker
judgments.judge_note: Rounds 003-009 now cover repeated health measurements plus explicit target and progress variants across blood-pressure, blood-count, glucose, exercise, medication, immunization, body-measurement, weight-loss, calorie-control, activity-goal, growth, and medical-progress sheets. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, normalize_headers, create_pivot_summary, flag_outliers, and protect_formula_cells; a plausible verifier is to append new measurements or goals, preserve threshold comparisons and summaries, and keep durable progress views coherent. I am still holding it below roadmap because round-009 resolves the research question in the negative rather than promoting it: the new evidence sharpens the threshold-aware measurement family, but too much of the remaining corpus still leans on printable charts, reference-band comparisons, or light logs instead of workbook-native protected summaries or in-sheet control gates. That is enough to stop further collection and keep the pattern as a recurring non-roadmap boundary, but not enough to pull it into the implementation fixture set.

judgments.title: Loan repayment calculator
judgments.judge_note: Amortization schedules are robustly supported across template sites and open-source workbooks, including extra-payment and balloon-loan variants. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are protect_formula_cells, extend_table_formulas, add_data_validation, and join_lookup; a plausible verifier is to change loan inputs or extra payments and confirm the schedule, payoff date, and remaining-balance columns recalculate without manual repair.

judgments.title: Project status dashboard
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as too broad: the lone operating-monitoring sheet is a generic management workbook, not a stable spreadsheet-native project dashboard pattern with a repeatable row-to-summary structure.

judgments.title: Purchase order control
judgments.judge_note: Across rounds 001-006 the evidence now converges on a bounded PO-control workflow: request and approval intake, printable PO issuance, status-bearing order tracking, and receipt or invoice handoff checkpoints before full reconciliation begins. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, generate_printable_form, protect_formula_cells, append_structured_rows, and group_summarize; a plausible verifier is to create or extend purchase-order rows, update approval, delivery, payment, or receipt checkpoints, and confirm the PO sheet preserves totals and handoff state without drifting into three-way-match logic.

judgments.title: Asset lifecycle register
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as duplicate: the current evidence collapses into inventory control plus maintenance logging, without a distinct acquisition-to-retirement register pattern.

judgments.title: Cash flow monitor
judgments.judge_note: Round-003 strengthens the opening-to-closing balance continuity boundary with direct cash-statement, forecast, and carry-forward examples. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are roll_forward_period, copy_period_sheet, protect_formula_cells, extend_table_formulas, group_summarize, and create_pivot_summary; a plausible verifier is to roll a period forward, edit inflow or outflow lines, and confirm the closing balance propagates cleanly into the next period.

judgments.title: Sales pipeline tracker
judgments.judge_note: Round-003 resolves the single-publisher concern: stage-driven opportunity tables, weighted forecasts, and close-date review now recur across multiple source families. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, normalize_headers, create_pivot_summary, group_summarize, and generate_printable_form; a plausible verifier is to append or edit opportunities, update stage or probability, and confirm forecast totals and stage summaries refresh without manual cleanup.

judgments.title: Student gradebook
judgments.judge_note: Rounds 003-005 now reinforce the roadmap case with weighted categories, excused-work handling, grading-scale variation, and assignment-column growth across multiple workbook families. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, extend_table_formulas, group_summarize, join_lookup, and protect_formula_cells; a plausible verifier is to add an assessment column, update scores, weights, or excused flags, and confirm student totals, class summaries, and locked grading formulas remain synchronized.

judgments.title: Safety compliance register
judgments.judge_note: Round-004 resolves the one-publisher problem with direct non-Smartsheet risk-register evidence that preserves risk rows, ratings, mitigation ownership, and open-risk review. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, protect_formula_cells, generate_printable_form, flag_outliers, and group_summarize; a plausible verifier is to append or edit risk rows, change severity or status, and confirm the prioritized open-risk summary still matches the underlying register.

judgments.title: Timesheet hours log
judgments.judge_note: Timesheet evidence spans dated hour entry, breaks, overtime, and payroll-adjacent totals across multiple sources. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are append_structured_rows, extend_table_formulas, add_data_validation, normalize_headers, and copy_period_sheet; a plausible verifier is to add dated work entries and break values, then confirm daily totals, overtime, and pay rollups stay correct.

judgments.title: Procurement reconciliation sheet
judgments.judge_note: Round-003 turns procurement reconciliation into a stable document-match pattern centered on PO, receipt, and invoice alignment. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are reconcile_tables, normalize_headers, add_data_validation, protect_formula_cells, and create_pivot_summary; a plausible verifier is to import or update PO, receipt, and invoice tables and confirm mismatch flags and match summaries update deterministically.

judgments.title: Warehouse reorder tracker
judgments.judge_note: The refined snapshot-based inventory pattern is clearly supported by reorder-oriented stock lists with on-hand quantity, cost, and low-stock signaling. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are flag_outliers, create_pivot_summary, add_data_validation, normalize_headers, and join_lookup; a plausible verifier is to change on-hand quantities or reorder thresholds and confirm restock flags and summary values refresh without breaking the table.

judgments.title: Training completion matrix
judgments.judge_note: Round-003 resolves the round-002 source-family concentration by adding several non-Smartsheet person-by-requirement matrices with completion or proficiency states. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, normalize_headers, extend_table_formulas, group_summarize, create_pivot_summary, and generate_printable_form; a plausible verifier is to add employees or requirements, update completion states, and confirm the grid and gap summaries stay aligned.

judgments.title: Event planning runbook
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as too broad: round-004 cleans up the trigger mapping, but the added evidence only reinforces that event task boards drift into generic project tracking while event budgets drift into budget-control sheets, not one coherent spreadsheet-native runbook pattern.

judgments.title: Client contact master
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as unsupported: the business-template catalog mentions many entities, but it does not provide a direct client-master workbook shape.

judgments.title: Quality inspection log
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as unsupported: risk and corrective-action sheets are adjacent, but they are not inspection logs with measured values and pass-fail outcomes.

judgments.title: Vendor performance scorecard
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as unsupported: bid comparison is adjacent procurement analysis, not a repeated supplier performance scorecard.

judgments.title: Insurance claim tracker
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as unsupported: none of the extracted or raw evidence rounds contains a direct insurance-claims workbook with claim status, follow-up dates, and document control.

judgments.title: Research data log
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as not spreadsheet-specific for this taxonomy: the data-contract authoring workbook is structured metadata capture, not a recurring research-log pattern.

judgments.title: Construction cost tracker
judgments.judge_note: Rounds 004-006 now hold the narrowed active-tracking boundary across direct cost trackers, WBS-driven budget-versus-actual sheets, change-order logs, and schedule-aware earned-value views. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are extend_table_formulas, add_data_validation, protect_formula_cells, group_summarize, and create_pivot_summary; a plausible verifier is to append or revise cost rows, change orders, or period spend, and confirm variance, cumulative cost, and forecast-style rollups stay synchronized without reintroducing estimate-only or bid-comparison sheets.

judgments.title: Shift roster planner
judgments.judge_note: Round-003 sharpens shift rosters into a coverage-and-assignment pattern with weekly, monthly, rotating, and availability-based variants across several publishers. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are copy_period_sheet, add_data_validation, normalize_headers, group_summarize, and generate_printable_form; a plausible verifier is to roll the schedule forward, change assignments or availability, and confirm coverage summaries and conflict indicators stay coherent.

judgments.title: Expense policy checker
judgments.judge_note: Rejected in round-009 and kept retired: across rounds 003-009 the evidence still does not show a workbook-native policy gate with explicit formulas, validations, or locked rule cells that block or flag non-compliant claims inside the sheet. Round-009 adds no direct reopening evidence, and the strongest prior material still stops at reimbursement routing or over-limit approval handling, so the safer judgment remains to keep this pattern off the active frontier unless a true in-sheet checker appears.

judgments.title: Fleet dispatch board
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as unsupported: a staffing shift schedule is not a fleet dispatch board with vehicles, routes, and delivery state.

judgments.title: Compliance action register
judgments.judge_note: Round-003 turns corrective-action tracking into a stable cross-source register pattern with issue, owner, due date, status, and closure evidence. Concrete Sheet Ops candidates are add_data_validation, protect_formula_cells, group_summarize, create_pivot_summary, and generate_printable_form; a plausible verifier is to append actions, update ownership or closure state, and confirm due-date and closure summaries remain consistent.

judgments.title: Lab sample tracker
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as unsupported: no extracted or raw record shows sample identifiers, collection timing, and result tracking in a lab workbook.

judgments.title: Membership renewal monitor
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as unsupported: the corpus still lacks membership renewal sheets with expiration cycles and notice tracking.

judgments.title: Donation campaign tracker
judgments.judge_note: Rejected as unsupported: no direct donor or campaign workbook appears in the current evidence corpus.
